title: next_id() clock-seeded AtomicU64 design is correct for library context
description: email.rs:738-753: next_id() uses OnceLock to seed an AtomicU64 from SystemTime on first call, then monotonically increments. This gives collision-resistant IDs without external deps (UUID, rand) and without a global Mutex. The docstring correctly explains the caveats. A future contributor might suggest replacing with a simple counter or with UUIDs; the current design is right for a no-external-deps library that still needs cross-restart ID uniqueness.
